subject: art-design

moments.title: First readymade
moments.body: Duchamp mounts a bicycle wheel onto a stool in his studio. The combination is later cited as the first 'readymade'.
moments.takeaway: An informal studio experiment seeded a category that would outlast its physical examples.

moments.title: Fountain submitted
moments.body: A signed urinal is submitted to the Society of Independent Artists in New York. The committee refuses to display it. The original disappears; later versions are 1960s replicas.
moments.takeaway: The work's status as art became tied to the institutional refusal rather than the object itself.

moments.title: Fountain voted most influential 20th-century artwork
moments.body: A poll of 500 British art-world figures, organised by Gordon's gin in association with the Turner Prize, places Fountain first.
moments.takeaway: Cultural canonisation can crown the originally rejected.

now.title: Conceptual art today
now.body: Contemporary art frequently treats the idea as the work. Museum collections include certificates of authenticity for works that can be physically remade.
now.open_questions: How do generative AI and NFTs reframe the dematerialised art object?

reflection: Duchamp's gesture continues to organise debates about what counts as art, more than a century after the original urinal.
